Casey plays the guitar with Hudson's arms! 😂🎸 | Not My Arms | Disney Channel
Can Hudson Stone and Casey Trotter work together when they can't use their own arms?! Watch the Camp Rock 3 stars take on the Not My Arms Challenge as they team up to play instruments, make crafts, and more!

Camp Rock 3 is available on Disney Channel and Disney+.
